name: the migration adds world_seed beside city_seed instead of renaming it, which is the silent-empty-world failure this rename was most at risk of
old: alter table baked_tile rename column city_seed to world_seed;
new: alter table baked_tile add column world_seed bytea;

name: the index keeps the old word while the column it leads on carries the new one
old: alter index baked_tile_by_city rename to baked_tile_by_world;

name: the repository asks the old column for a world
old: "where world_seed = %s and (%s::int is null or lod = %s) "
new: "where city_seed = %s and (%s::int is null or lod = %s) "

name: the record path reads the column's spelling out of a tile record that does not carry it
the route drops the alias, so the wire moves with the column
the route answers the new spelling in a body key nothing reads
old: content={"city_seed": world_seed, "tiles": [tile.document() for tile in tiles]},
new: content={"world_seed": world_seed, "tiles": [tile.document() for tile in tiles]},
